_comment: Verifier profiles. The verifier parent never imports candidate code. It checks out the EXACT revision privately, rejects the diff statically (protected/editable paths, hook files, stdlib/verifier shadowing, non-source/bytecode/binary/symlink files, non-UTF-8 encodings, the static_scan AST tripwire and, for fixture profiles, the pure_modules pure-function rule over every .py under editable_paths: a strict AST/builtin/attribute ALLOWLIST: top-level functions with plain positional params, arithmetic/comparison (no is), if/while/for-over-range, tuples/lists, a fixed builtin set, module attributes only from allowlisted modules, no attribute access on values, no dict/set literals or comprehensions, no try/classes/lambdas; __all__ of str constants allowed; relative imports only to scanned modules), and runs every process that executes candidate code inside a bubblewrap sandbox (read-only /usr runtime, fresh writable checkout copy, private /tmp, no network, no view of state/code/venv/home/workspace; no sandbox = fail closed) with the system interpreter, a scrubbed env and no secret anywhere. Trusted files are hashed before/after each run (change = TAMPER failure). oracle profiles (required for fixture-*): the parent sends an exhaustive small grid ([-16,16]^2), boundary pairs, keyword/mixed-form and aliased-equal-argument copies, bool cases, magnitudes up to 2**4096, fresh random inputs and 50 fresh large-magnitude draws per function drawn separately for each run, one at a time to the oracle child in 3 varied neutral environments with different address-space limits (low/4GiB/none) distinct effective hash seeds and recursion headroom equal to a real top-level call (results must agree) and recomputes every expected value from omo_grok/oracles.py (assurance=oracle). The unittest_child.py run of expected_tests is advisory: a negative report fails, a positive one alone does not pass. Profiles without an oracle are assurance=cooperative (forgeable by adversarial code; the gate requires code_review and qa on the same revision from Bots outside the executor's Bot and independence group, unless the job's approval accepts reduced assurance). Non-python profiles need exit_code_only: true. OMO_VERIFY_TEMPLATE anywhere fails closed.
